# English template for translating the Darkest Dungeon accessibility mod's own spoken strings.
#
# GENERATED by Mod\gen-lang-template.ps1 from Mod\src\core\axstrings.inc -- do not edit this
# copy; edit the .inc and regenerate. English itself is built into the mod, so this file is
# NEVER loaded: it is the starting point for a new Mod\lang\<language>.txt.
#
# HOW TO USE
# 1. Copy this file to Mod\lang\<language>.txt, named after the game's INTERNAL language name
#    (french.txt, spanish.txt, italian.txt, polish.txt, russian.txt, czech.txt, ...).
# 2. Replace the English text after each = with your translation. Translate the WHOLE line
#    naturally; word order may differ from English freely.
# 3. Keep every printf placeholder (%d, %s) exactly as in English and in the same order. A
#    line whose placeholders differ is rejected at load and stays English. %% is a literal %.
# 4. Delete or comment out (#) any line you do not translate -- it stays English either way.
# 5. Save as UTF-8. Send the file to the mod's maintainer; it is compiled into the mod by
#    Mod\build.ps1 and takes effect at the next game start in that language.
# Full format notes: Mod\lang\README.txt. A finished example: Mod\lang\german.txt.

KMD_NAV_DOWN=Move down.
KMD_NAV_LEFT=Move left.
KMD_NAV_RIGHT=Move right.
KMD_TIP_BACK=Scroll up in the tooltip buffer, walk hallway 1 tile north on map.
KMD_TIP_FWD=Scroll down in the tooltip buffer, walk hallway 1 tile south on map.
KMD_TILE_LEFT=Walk hallway 1 tile west on map.
KMD_TILE_RIGHT=Walk hallway 1 tile east on map.
KMD_MAP_PARTY=Return the map cursor to the party.
KMT_RESOURCES=Jump to Resource Bar.
KMT_LOG=Toggle Activity Log.
KMT_FORWARD=Embark.
KMT_TRINKETS=Toggle trinket inventory.
KMT_HEROES=Jump to hero roster/party lineup; on the provisioning screen, the next section.
KMT_HEROES_BACK=Go back one section: the previous stop on the provisioning screen; elsewhere in town, the same as Tab.
KMT_JUMP_ABBEY=Jump to the Abbey.
KMT_JUMP_SMITH=Jump to the Blacksmith.
KMT_JUMP_COACH=Jump to the Stage Coach. On a roster, party lineup or recruit row: open the focused hero's character sheet.
KMT_JUMP_DISTRICTS=Jump to the Districts.
KMT_JUMP_GUILD=Jump to the Guild.
KMT_JUMP_MEMOIRS=Jump to the Ancestor's Memoirs.

KMT_JUMP_SURVIVALIST=Jump to the Survivalist.
KMT_JUMP_WAGON=Jump to the Nomad Wagon.
KMT_JUMP_GRAVEYARD=Jump to the Graveyard.
KMT_JUMP_CIRCUS=Jump to the Butcher's Circus.
KMT_STRIP_PREV=In building screen, jump to previous building.
KMT_STRIP_NEXT=In building screen, jump to next building.
KMT_UPGRADES=Open building upgrades.
KMT_CONFIRM=Open, buy, or select the focused row.
KMT_CONFIRM_STACK=Buy as many as fit, sell the whole stack back, or sell the focused trinket.
KMT_REORDER=Party lineup: pick the focused hero up; on another slot, swap them.
KMT_SLOT_CLEAR=Party lineup: empty the focused slot.
KMT_NAV_UP=Move up: previous row.
KMT_NAV_DOWN=Move down: next row.
KMT_NAV_LEFT=Move left: previous column or slot.
KMT_NAV_RIGHT=Move right: next column or slot.
KMT_TIP_BACK=Read the focused row's details, scrolling back.
KMT_TIP_FWD=Read the focused row's details, scrolling forward.
KMT_RANK_NOW=Blacksmith and Guild: switch the detail to the current rank.
KMT_RANK_NEXT=Blacksmith and Guild: switch the detail to the rank being bought.

KMT_SHEET_SLOT2=Character sheet: assign the focused skill to slot 2.
